name: Bloom Room
summary: A Lahore flower and plant shop with a stem-by-stem bouquet builder, slots by area and a care meter
about: A multi-page shop for a Lahore florist with same-day delivery, in cream, blush and fern green. The bouquet builder draws each stem into the bouquet one at a time, then folds the paper and ties the ribbon, and every plant has a care meter whose watering can tips and pours while the soil moisture rises. Checkout has two-hour delivery slots by area, a handwritten card note and cash, bank or card payment, and each order can be followed on a drawn map with a rider timeline.
how: Open a page from the top bar: Bouquets, Plants, Build your own, Care journal, Track order, your account or the bag
Filter bouquets by occasion, colour and price, or plants by care level, light and pet safety; the plant quiz suggests one
In Build your own, add stems with + and watch each settle into the bouquet, then pick a paper and a ribbon and add it to the bag
Press Water now on any care meter to tip the can and pour; the soil dries live and the care journal logs every watering
At checkout choose a day and a two-hour slot for your area, write the card note and pay by cash, bank transfer or the demo card
Follow the order on the track page, where the rider moves along the drawn map and the timeline fills in
Press Ctrl+K to search everything; reset demo data in Account settings
